edits.text: 1. PRELIMINARY STATEMENT. Defendant responds to Plaintiff’s First Requests for Production. These responses are made based on Defendant’s present information and investigation and are subject to the General Objections set forth below. Defendant reserves the right to amend, supplement, or modify these responses as discovery progresses and additional information becomes available.
edits.name: replace

edits.text: 2. GENERAL OBJECTIONS. Defendant objects to each request to the extent it seeks documents or information protected by the attorney-client privilege, work-product doctrine, joint-defense or common-interest privilege, or any other applicable privilege or immunity. Defendant further objects to each request to the extent it is overbroad, unduly burdensome, seeks irrelevant material, is disproportionate to the needs of the case, calls for confidential or proprietary information, or seeks documents outside Defendant’s possession, custody, or control. Any production will be limited accordingly and no objection is waived by responding to any particular request.
edits.name: replace

edits.text: 3. PRODUCTION. Subject to and without waiving the foregoing objections, Defendant will produce responsive, non-privileged documents within its possession, custody, or control, as such documents are located after a reasonable search.
edits.name: replace

edits.text: 4. PRIVILEGE LOG. Any documents withheld on the basis of privilege or other protection will be identified on a privilege log to the extent required by the applicable rules and after a reasonable opportunity to review and confirm the basis for withholding.

I also clarified the privilege-log timing to state it will be served promptly as withholding determinations are made, while preserving the qualification that finalization depends on review and applicable rules.

We are in the process of finalizing the custodians and sources to be searched, including relevant email accounts and shared repositories, and will provide supplementation as that process is completed. Any material withheld on privilege or work-product grounds will be identified on a privilege log without undue delay and in accordance with the applicable rules.
